quote:
▪▪Native seeds, seedlings, or 
source populations are readily 
available. In the absence of 
human intervention, the lack of 
sufficient source populations for 
seeds and seedlings can prevent 
the reemergence of native trees in 
the landscape. Likewise, if seed-
dispersing birds and mammals do 
not have viable populations or are 
not able to move freely across the 
landscape, reemergence of trees can 
be hindered.

relationship.note: Availability of viable native propagule sources and dispersers supports passive recovery; no numeric calibration or executable membership function.

context.note: process: Independent WRI review. Native PDF page 38 / printed page 34, Box 5. Institutional synthesis of historical cases, not a causal trial. No external nursery procurement in quoted passage. Source cautions no factor proven universally necessary/sufficient. Calibration hold: no amount/distance/density or scores supplied. VONT regeneration_potential pending_review, distinct from FMNR-specific rootstock_presence.
context.practice_as_described: Passive forest landscape restoration: recovery of native trees without human intervention.
context.intended_use: T4 qualitative directional evidence for passive regeneration; pending human review, no numeric curve or default weight.

model_use.note: Source identifies ecological prerequisites through institutional interpretation of historical cases, not fitted suitability calculation.

context.numeric_calibration: No density, distance, viability amount, ordered classes or score boundaries. Increasing means qualitative availability/capacity supports recovery, not a calibrated monotonic function.
context.review_needed: Confirm passive-family assignment and qualitative regeneration-potential direction; approval cannot activate numeric thresholds.
